challenge: Signalpost: Build An Agent That Finds Company Information
jbox_bonus_category: Official JBOX Integration (Håvard Liltved Dalen / Fronted)
description: An evidence-first autonomous research dashboard built for JBOX that investigates Norwegian companies via Brønnøysundregistrene (BRREG) with 100% verified provenance and live change diff tracking.
jbox_prompt: Create a full-stack Next.js 14 web application called 'SignalPost' that serves as a verified corporate intelligence workbench for Norwegian enterprises. It takes a 9-digit Norwegian Organization Number (organisasjonsnummer) or company name, validates it via Modulo 11 checksum algorithm, queries Brønnøysundregistrene (data.brreg.no) REST APIs, and displays an evidence-first corporate dossier with zero hallucination. It includes tabs for Entity Overview, Board & Management (roller), Sub-Entities (underenheter), Evidence Provenance Links (source URL, verbatim quote, timestamp), and a Change Diff Timeline tracking updates between daily runs. The UI features a dark sleek theme with cyan and blue accents, export to JSON/JSONL, and a 100-point benchmark report badge.
